summary: Planner is implemented as agent_core::planner with draft_plan, validate_plan, freeze_plan, and explain_plan. It uses ModelBroker only for structured drafting and summary, validates semantic tools through ToolRouter, rejects unsafe plans, freezes deterministic plan hashes, and emits IntentReceived/PlanFrozen without preparing effects.

acceptance.criterion: A service recovery intent produces a frozen plan with diagnostic steps and a gated restart step.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::planner::tests::service_recovery_intent_freezes_reviewable_plan drafts through StubModelProvider, validates svc.status and svc.restart, and marks restart-service as approval-gated.

acceptance.criterion: Planner cannot freeze a plan containing shell.exec or unknown tools.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::planner::tests::planner_rejects_shell_exec_and_unknown_tools rejects both shell.exec and unknown.tool via ToolRouter before freeze.

acceptance.criterion: Planner cannot freeze a write step without rollback requirement.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::planner::tests::planner_rejects_write_without_rollback rejects fs.write.diff when rollback.required is false.

acceptance.criterion: PlanFrozen appears in audit before any EffectPrepared for that run.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::planner::tests::audit_order_has_plan_frozen_before_any_effect_prepared checks IntentReceived then PlanFrozen and absence of EffectPrepared during planning.

acceptance.criterion: Freezing the same deterministic plan produces the same plan hash.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::planner::tests::freezing_same_plan_produces_same_hash freezes the same PlanSpec twice and compares hashes.

planner_contract.validator: ToolRouter plus verification, rollback, and secret-like value checks
planner_contract.side_effect_path: none; Planner freezes PlanSpec and never emits EffectPrepared
